svg.title: Karate Monkey / Revelate Rifter XL - 14S8P 21700 stencil (1:1, mm)
svg.text: free zone: BMS on edge, leads,
Face A shown. Pink = cell + on this face, blue = cell − on this face. Numbers = series group.
Dashed = series strips on face A (2-3 ... 12-13). Face B strips: 1-2, 3-4 ... 13-14.
Pack terminals, both on face A: group 1 = Pack+ (seat-tube end), group 14 = Pack− (front end).
